description: This file is a Perl script for manipulating NSLU2 firmware images. It includes functions to parse, modify, assemble, and write firmware partitions, handling binary data, headers, and trailers related to firmware components such as RedBoot, Kernel, Ramdisk, and others. It also supports creating new firmware images from specified files and parameters, as well as extracting parts from existing images.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads input data to a specified total length with 0xff bytes, used for flash memory padding.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Calculates the next multiple of the block size greater than or equal to a given length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of blocks required to hold a given data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary entry for a partition with name, base address, size, and optional skip regions.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a 0x100-length partition entry buffer and returns its components or terminates on invalid data.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Checks if data contains a RedBoot partition table and extracts it.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses the partition table and returns an array of partition info references.

methods.name: jffs2Block
methods.description: Creates a dummy JFFS2 block for filesystems.

methods.name: writeOut
methods.description: Writes data to a specified file.

methods.name: trailerData
methods.description: Generates binary trailer data, although not used at the moment.

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Outputs formatted information of the RedBoot trailer contained in firmware data.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the Loader partition and fixes offsets for Kernel and Ramdisk partitions.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Replaces or updates partition entries based on a firmware's actual partition table.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Builds a binary partition table from in-memory partition information.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Assembles the firmware image from partitions and writes it to a file.

methods.name: checkPartitionTable
methods.description: Sanity check for partition table data, mainly for testing.

methods.name: printPartitions
methods.description: Displays information about current partitions.

methods.name: defaultPartitions
methods.description: Returns a default set of firmware partitions with predefined offsets and sizes.

methods.name: readInFirmware
methods.description: Reads a firmware image file and splits it into partitions, parsing headers where applicable.

methods.name: writeOutFirmwareParts
methods.description: Writes partition data back into individual files.

methods.name: readInFirmwareParts
methods.description: Reads partition files into memory, preparing data for firmware assembly.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Calculates and assigns start addresses and sizes to partitions for firmware assembly.
